item.text: {"explanation":"A begin is atomic and succeeds only when its job ID has never been begun and every requested resource is free. Successful jobs retain their requested resources through active and prepared phases. Prepare is valid only for active jobs. Commit is valid only for prepared jobs, records the ID as done, and releases resources. Abort is valid only for active or prepared jobs, marks the job aborted, and releases resources. Blocked begins leave all state unchanged and do not consume the ID; terminal jobs remain recorded so their IDs cannot be reused.","program":"function solve({config,state,event}){let s=state||{jobs:{},held:{},done:[]},e=event,id=e.id,status=\"invalid\",j=s.jobs[id];if(e.type===\"begin\"){let ok=!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(s.jobs,id);if(ok)for(let r of e.resources)if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(s.held,r)){ok=false;break}if(ok){s.jobs[id]={phase:\"active\",resources:e.resources.slice()};for(let r of e.resources)s.held[r]=id;status=\"begun\"}else status=\"blocked\"}else if(e.type===\"prepare\"){if(j&&j.phase===\"active\"){j.phase=\"prepared\";status=\"prepared\"}}else if(e.type===\"commit\"){if(j&&j.phase===\"prepared\"){for(let r of j.resources)delete s.held[r];j.phase=\"committed\";s.done.push(id);status=\"committed\"}}else if(e.type===\"abort\"){if(j&&(j.phase===\"active\"||j.phase===\"prepared\")){for(let r of j.resources)delete s.held[r];j.phase=\"aborted\";status=\"aborted\"}}let held={};for(let r of config.resources)if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(s.held,r))held[r]=s.held[r];return{state:s,output:{status:status,held:held,done:s.done.slice().sort()}}}"}
